author: GamingBolt
description:
Empathy may be a newfound way to go about life in Leonida, but in Grand Theft Auto, chaos reigns. It's the force that drives us to do otherwise unsavory things, sometimes to see how the world reacts. Grand Theft Auto 6 is no different, and even if some crimes involve more structure, mayhem is waiting to be unleashed at almost every opportunity.

You'll probably find this out early when attempting to commit a robbery for the first time. In GTA 5, the process was pretty straightforward. Walk into a store, point a gun at the clerk, and wait for them to give you money in a bag. Sure, you could speed up the process and fill their intimidation meter quicker, and they may have a shotgun ready when you flee. But that's more or less it (with a Wanted level gained shortly after). Cut and dry, with the more complicated tactics reserved for the bigger, more scripted heists.
title: THIS GTA 6 Gameplay Mechanic Is SIMPLY MIND-BLOWING

author: GamingBolt
description:
2026will go down as one of the best years in gaming, and that's without evencounting Grand Theft Auto 6. However, for every gem, hidden or otherwise, thatdeserves your attention, hundreds of other titles exist that aren't worth thetrouble. And among that bunch are some truly abysmal offerings that serve aslittle more than black holes for your time, energy and faith in gaming.

So naturally, we've scanned that dreg heap to pick the ten worst games of theyear in no particular order.
title: 10 of the WORST Games We Played in 2026

author: GamingBolt
description:
For months, the expectation was that Grand Theft Auto 6 would run at 30 frames per second. You'd expect there to be less shock when both consoles were finally announced to target the same frame rate – not 60 FPS – and 1440p resolution. And you'd be somewhat right, except Rockstar also confirmed this for PS5 Pro. At $200 more than the base PS5, does it even offer any tangible benefits?

The answer is: Sort of. It's the only platform to feature ray-traced shadows, and there was the inherent expectation that PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution would lead to...something better. But what? We're going to go over all that, but it's also worth highlighting a recent discovery: That GTA 6 can run at even higher than 60 frames per second on Xbox Series X. With a catch. Because of course there is.
title: Can GTA 6 Run at 60fps? And Which Version Should You Play?
